title: Decision framing
activation: a choice between real alternatives where being wrong has a cost
architecture, vendor, build-vs-buy, sequencing, or direction calls
outcomes: a decision record with options, baseline, reversibility, objection, pre-mortem
inputs: the request in the person's own words
the project constitution when one exists
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: the recommendation is presented as a decision for the person, never applied
